title: pelargonium peltatum var. clypeatum
intro: Pelargonium peltatum var. clypeatum, commonly known as Resurrection Plant, is a succulent plant species that is known for its unique ability to revive itself after drying out. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and stress, as well as acting as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Pelargonium peltatum var. clypeatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
